parsed.g: Create a milestone for the upcoming task of merging all branches to main, with a start date of March 15, 2044 and an end date of March 30, 2044, in the Byte Blaze / dotfiles GitLab project.
P_t: Navigated to the Issues section of the Byte Blaze / dotfiles GitLab project
Navigated to the Milestones section under Issues
Clicked 'New milestone' to open the new milestone creation form
Entered the title 'Merge all branches to main' in the Title field
R_t: Clear the corrupted Start Date field and enter the correct value '2044-03-15'
Clear the corrupted Due Date field and enter the correct value '2044-03-30'
Click the 'Create milestone' button to submit the form
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the 'New Milestone' page for the Byte Blaze / dotfiles GitLab project. The Title field contains 'Merge all branches to main'. The Start Date field (id 5590) is focused and contains the corrupted value '2060-08-094-03-30'. The Due Date field (id 5594) contains the corrupted value '004404'. Neither date field contains a valid date. The 'Create milestone' button is present and enabled.
C: The date fields use a special date-picker widget that does not accept plain text typing via repeated 'type' actions without first clearing the field; each successive type appends to the existing corrupted value rather than replacing it.
The Start Date must be set to 2044-03-15 (March 15, 2044).
The Due Date must be set to 2044-03-30 (March 30, 2044).
The milestone must be created in the Byte Blaze / dotfiles project.

F_t.cause: The type action appended text to the Start Date field rather than setting it. The field value remained as '2044-03-15' initially but the calendar picker showed April 2026, indicating the field did not correctly parse the typed value as a date.

The type action was directed at the Due Date field but the Start Date field was still focused (as shown by the calendar picker appearing on the Start Date field). The Due Date field showed '0' instead of the intended date.

Repeated typing into the already-corrupted Start Date field appended '2044-03-15' to the existing corrupted value '2044-07-3044-03-30', resulting in '2044-07-3044-03-302044-03-15'. The field does not support plain text replacement via type action.
The Due Date field still had focus issues and the Start Date field continued to accumulate appended text. The Due Date field showed '004' instead of a valid date.

Again appended to the corrupted Start Date field, resulting in '2053-07-294-03-302044-03-15'. The calendar picker jumped to July 2053, confirming the field is accumulating typed characters rather than being set to the intended value.
Due Date field continued to show corrupted value '0044' instead of the intended date. The Start Date field accumulated further text.
Start Date field value became '2059-10-114-03-30' after appending, calendar showed October 2059. The field continues to accumulate typed characters.
Due Date field value became '0044' (still corrupted). Start Date field accumulated further text to '2059-10-114-03-302044-03-15'.

Start Date field value became '2060-08-094-03-30' (further corruption). The type action continues to append rather than replace, as confirmed by the ground-truth DOM showing the field value as '2060-08-094-03-30'.

K_t: The milestone title 'Merge all branches to main' is correctly entered in the Title field.

The date fields in GitLab's milestone form use a special date-picker widget; using the 'type' action appends characters to the existing field value rather than replacing it, causing progressive corruption.
To correctly set the date fields, the agent should first clear each field (using the 'Clear start date' / 'Clear due date' links, ids 5591 and 5595) before attempting to enter a date value.
The Start Date field (id 5590) currently contains the corrupted value '2060-08-094-03-30'.
The Due Date field (id 5594) currently contains the corrupted value '004404'.
The 'Clear start date' link has id 5591 and the 'Clear due date' link has id 5595.
The 'Create milestone' button (id 5603) is present and enabled on the page.
The project is Byte Blaze / dotfiles and the milestone form is at the New Milestone page under Issues > Milestones.
